batches.name: Pennsauken and Merchantville
batches.why: Three neighbouring single-church parishes with no shared pastor named. St. Peter prints with John Patrick (church-bulletin.org 502); Mary, Queen of All Saints's directory website is the old St. Cecilia domain, which links maryqueenofallsaints.org/currbulletin3.pdf.

batches.name: Collingswood, West Collingswood and Haddon Township
batches.why: St. Teresa of Calcutta (St. John, Collingswood and Holy Saviour, Westmont; GCatholic still says 'Blessed Teresa'), Most Precious Blood (bilingual English and Vietnamese) and St. Joseph the Worker (St. Vincent Pallotti and St. Aloysius, Oaklyn; site moved to sjwparish.net). Two merged parishes with two churches each.

batches.name: Cherry Hill and the Korean mission of St. Yi Yun Il
batches.why: Four Cherry Hill parishes, each with one church, and the Korean Catholic mission. GCatholic puts St. Yi Yun Il at St. Mary's address (2001 Springdale Rd.); the directory gives 1219 Delsea Dr., Westville. Decide whether it is a church row under St. Mary's bulletin, its own row, or excluded. christourlight.net answers 403 to probe url but loads in the browser (/home/bulletins).

batches.name: Haddonfield, Gibbsboro and Berlin, with Mater Ecclesiae
batches.why: Christ the King, St. Andrew the Apostle and St. Simon Stock (Our Lady of Mount Carmel, Berlin and St. Edward, Pine Hill) are ordinary parishes. Mater Ecclesiae, Berlin is a Traditional Latin Mass community the directory calls a 'Mission' with a Rector (with it and the two Korean missions set aside, the directory's other 62 entries are the diocese's 62 parishes): check that it publishes its own bulletin (materecclesiae.org/bulletin/).

batches.name: Runnemede, Blackwood and Lindenwold
batches.why: Holy Child (St. Teresa and St. Maria Goretti, Runnemede), Our Lady of Hope (St. Agnes and St. Jude, Blackwood) and Our Lady of Guadalupe Parish Shrine, Lindenwold. Two-church merged parishes: check whether the second church still has Mass.

batches.name: Atco, Sicklerville and Williamstown
batches.why: Christ the Redeemer (Assumption, Atco; Sacred Heart, Cedar Brook; St. Anthony, Waterford), St. Charles Borromeo (Sicklerville; both rosters say Washington Township; its domain now redirects to churchofscb.org, which answers 403 to probe url) and Our Lady of Peace (John Patrick 525).

batches.name: Deptford, Mantua, Sewell and Turnersville
batches.why: Four Gloucester County parishes along Route 47/55: Infant Jesus (St. Margaret, Woodbury Heights; St. John Vianney, Deptford), Incarnation, Mantua (the GCatholic website is a dead acswebnetworks page; the directory gives incarnation-church.org), Holy Family, Sewell, and Sts. Peter and Paul, Turnersville.

batches.name: Woodbury, Paulsboro, Gibbstown and Swedesboro
batches.why: Two multi-church parishes, so only two in the batch: Holy Angels, Woodbury (St. Patrick, the Holy Angels 'worship center', St. Matthew, National Park, Holy Redeemer, Westville Grove) and St. Clare of Assisi (St. Joseph, Swedesboro; St. Michael, Gibbstown; St. John, Paulsboro). Check each church for current Mass.

batches.name: Glassboro and Clayton
batches.why: St. Bridget University Parish (Rowan University; churchofstbridget.com is dead, stbridgetup.org is current), Mary, Mother of Mercy (Our Lady of Lourdes, Glassboro; Our Lady Queen of Peace, Pitman) and St. Michael the Archangel, Clayton: GCatholic's parishofstmichaelthearchangel.org doesn't resolve and the directory's .com redirects to a spam site (thestudiotrack.com), so find the current site.

batches.name: Salem County and Mullica Hill
batches.why: St. Gabriel the Archangel, Carneys Point and the Catholic Community of the Holy Spirit, Mullica Hill (Holy Name of Jesus; St. Joseph, Woodstown; St. Ann, Elmer; John Patrick 6006). GCatholic lists St. Mary, Salem and Queen of the Apostles, Pennsville with no parish: they are presumably St. Gabriel's worship sites; check.

batches.name: Vineland
batches.why: St. Padre Pio (Our Lady of Pompeii; St. Mary), Christ the Good Shepherd (Sacred Heart; St. Isidore the Farmer) and Divine Mercy (St. Francis of Assisi; John Patrick 633). christtheshepherd.com is dead; the directory gives christtheshepherdvineland.org, whose bulletin page is headed 2022: check it is current.

batches.name: Millville and Newfield
batches.why: All Saints, Millville (St. Mary Magdalen church; the former St. John Bosco church was sold in 2020, and a new St. John Bosco Chapel on the parish campus was consecrated 2026-01-31 for daily Mass, Catholic Star Herald 2026-02-05) and Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament, Newfield.

batches.name: Hammonton, Collings Lakes and Mays Landing
batches.why: St. Mary of Mount Carmel, Hammonton (St. Joseph, St. Anthony of Padua, St. Martin de Porres; eCatholic 33982 on smmcp.net, and an old ParishesOnline subdomain), Our Lady of the Lakes (lakescatholic.com answers 403) and St. Vincent de Paul, Mays Landing, whose St. Bernard Mission, Dorothy the 2026 summer guide marks 'Currently not open'.

batches.name: Galloway, Egg Harbor City and Absecon, with St. Andrew Kim
batches.why: Our Lady of Perpetual Help (Assumption, Galloway; St. Nicholas, Egg Harbor City; the Our Lady of the Highway, Sea and Air shrine, Pomona, which GCatholic gives OLPH's website), St. Elizabeth Ann Seton, Absecon (the GCatholic domain stelizabethannseton.com is blocked as unsafe by an ISP filter; the directory gives setonabsecon.org) and the St. Andrew Kim Korean Catholic Mission, Absecon.

batches.name: Atlantic City and Brigantine
batches.why: The Parish of St. Monica (the four Atlantic City parishes merged in 2015: Our Lady Star of the Sea, St. Michael, St. Monica, St. Nicholas of Tolentine; its sites accatholic.org and saintmonicanac.org didn't answer) and St. Thomas the Apostle, Brigantine (John Patrick 661). The summer guide lists Mass at three of St. Monica's churches, not St. Monica itself.

batches.name: Margate, Ventnor, Longport and Linwood
batches.why: Holy Trinity Parish (Blessed Sacrament, Margate; Epiphany, Longport; St. James, Ventnor; and a Holy Trinity chapel at 100 N Jerome Ave. that GCatholic lists and the summer guide doesn't) and Our Lady of Sorrows, Linwood. holytrinitydownbeach.org answers 403 to probe url and loads in the browser (/news/bulletin).

batches.name: Egg Harbor Township, Northfield and Somers Point
batches.why: Three single-church parishes: St. Katharine Drexel (ParishesOnline 04/0903; the summer guide says all Masses are in Drexel Hall), St. Gianna Beretta Molla (John Patrick 636; has a Sunday Traditional Latin Mass) and St. Joseph, Somers Point (stjosephsomerspoint.com no longer resolves).

batches.name: Ocean City, Marmora and Sea Isle City
batches.why: St. Damien, Ocean City (St. Frances Cabrini, St. Augustine, Our Lady of Good Counsel), St. Maximilian Kolbe (Resurrection, Marmora; St. Casimir, Woodbine, Sunday Mass in summer only per the 2026 guide) and St. Joseph, Sea Isle City (John Patrick 6028). Seasonal Masses: read an off-season bulletin.

batches.name: Avalon, Stone Harbor and Cape May Court House
batches.why: St. Brendan the Navigator (Maris Stella, Avalon; St. Paul, Stone Harbor; the guide's schedule runs May 2 - October 1, 2026) and Our Lady of the Angels (John Patrick 564), whose St. Elizabeth, Goshen (Sunday 10:15 AM) is in the summer guide only, in no other roster.

batches.name: The Wildwoods, North Cape May and Cape May
batches.why: Notre Dame de la Mer (St. Ann, Wildwood; Assumption, Wildwood Crest; the directory's website path /notredame/ answers 404), St. John Neumann (St. John of God, North Cape May; St. Raymond, Villas) and Our Lady Star of the Sea, Cape May (St. Agnes Mission, Cape May Point, which the guide lists with a Sunday 8:30 AM; ladystarofthesea.org renders by JavaScript).

batches.name: City of Camden: Cathedral, St. Joseph Pro-Cathedral, Sacred Heart
batches.why: The three parishes left by the 2017 Camden reorganization (Catholic Star Herald, 2017-07-06): St. Joseph (Polish, 1010 Liberty St.) merged into the Cathedral, St. Anthony of Padua into St. Joseph Pro-Cathedral, and St. Josephine Bakhita (St. Bartholomew, St. Joan of Arc) into Sacred Heart. Check which of the five former churches still hold Mass and under whose bulletin. GCatholic omits both the Cathedral and the Pro-Cathedral; the Pro-Cathedral is ParishesOnline 03/0810. Also decide the Monastery of the Perpetual Rosary chapel.

batches.name: Gloucester City, Bellmawr and Haddon Heights
batches.why: The 2014 consolidation (Catholic Star Herald, 2014-05-08): the Emmaus community (Sacred Heart, Mount Ephraim; Holy Maternity, Audubon) and St. Francis, Barrington joined St. Rose of Lima; Mary, Mother of the Church, Bellmawr joined St. Joachim, whose own church is the former Annunciation (St. Anne, Westville was relegated in 2024). GCatholic still groups the four under St. Rita and Emmaus. Find which of those churches still hold Mass. St. Mary, Gloucester prints with John Patrick (6049).

batches.name: Holy Cross, Bridgeton
batches.why: One parish with five churches in GCatholic (Immaculate Conception, St. Mary and St. Teresa of Avila, Bridgeton; St. Michael, Cedarville; St. Anthony, Port Norris), so a batch of its own. Check which still hold Mass. parishholycross.org answers 403 to probe url and curl.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic's four Eastern Catholic entries: St. Michael, Cherry Hill, St. Nicholas, Millville and Sts. Peter and Paul, Williamstown (Ukrainian), and Our Lady Star of the East, Pleasantville (Maronite). Confirm each on its eparchy's list and exclude as other-jurisdiction.
